mechanisms_examined: minimum measured RTT and min+delta grouping
investigations.claim_probe_result: PASS on embedded base: production dispatch falls back to the slow path when the measured fast path has zero capacity score
investigations.causal_assessment: B1/B2 lose substantial goodput, but saturation is a congestion-window score, not physical qdisc utilization. Changing that policy to a bandwidth oracle would be a redesign, not a demonstrated implementation correction. M2 is already the median-goodput winner and was not eligible for a winner-cell rerun.
investigations.disposition: not admitted; no failing claim test or demonstrated causal violation
